about: An empty mask frame filled with a colour in place of a photo, as both phones write it: the frame's own fill on an image whose src is blank. Read and written back unchanged on both phones; spoken as 'Frame, filled' and the colour's name (spoken); skipped by picked photos (framesToFill) and dropped when a photo goes in. Android's FrameColourFillTest and the iPhone's FrameColourFillTests read it.
